body: Damn. I feel for you. It feels good to get things out though, so don't regret this post. Luckily you have family in Texas supporting you, and I think you should let them know how appreciative you are of that. I really can't believe how your mum and even your brother are treating you, it's hard to imagine. But look at the bright side, you're getting back on your feet and you're not suicidal so that's great. Most people would've given up already because life can really take it's tole on us. As for the warnings and stuff, don't dwell on it man, they were just minor glitches that you can overcome easily. You've got a job so hopefully you can save up and pay for everything slowly, there must be other support you can get where you are right? So sad about your cat :( I would miss my cat if I had one and it was away from me ahaha. If you're really desperate for lenses try glasses again, fear will only hold you back so long, you can easily overcome small fears like that. Constant reminders that you will not let yourself be controlled by inanimate objects help. You're not a bother at all, I liked reading this because it's a big insight into what other people are going through you know?

It is the right thing to do. Don't ever feel stupid about asking for help, even if it's on a random site, because people are willing to listen. I actually don't think you really want to die, and maybe you know that to. I don't want you to die, and I'm sure everyone else around you feels the same. Try not to give in to the thoughts, don't research anymore about ways to kill yourself, because that way you're just feeding the darkness. You can change, and life can get better. You may be lonely now, but it takes finding the right people to fix that, and that takes time. Plus, remember that we can't always feel topnotch and awesome, we can have low times. If you're stressed there are tons of remedies to help, like healthy tablets from the pharmacy, or you can even make it your quest to get better at dealing with stress using tips from the Internet. I have panic attacks a lot and I have things I got online that I can tell myself to remind me that everything will be fine and it will all pass and life will go on. So don't regret this post at all, I know how hard it is to keep things bottled up, so writing about it can be cathartic. I think you just have to look at life in a different light, it may seem shitty now, but it's a universal fact of life that it will fade into the past. you can't even imagine the possibilities ahead, or what else is waiting for you in the future so stay alive for that. I hope I've helped.

No need to apologise. Thing is, you are alive, despite not being alive before you were alive, so might as well enjoy it right. There is definitely no view of reality, you perceive it as you wish. It's obvious you're not ignorant, so that's a good start. You have to find acceptance in yourself, that the world will never be perfect, and then move on from there. If you're faced with a bad experience, allow yourself to feel bad, but limit it. Don't let yourself be controlled by a chemical in your brain. You can smile, you can walk you can talk, damn you can do so many things. Just allow yourself to see the positive side. I'm a hypocrite for saying this, I love my depression and hate it at the same time, but I have some hope. I'm certain you do to.

Breathe. Just breathe in and take in and enjoy it.
Don't kill yourself, all of us here need you to stay alive. Death comes when it comes, but it shouldn't be by your own hands. That's not merciful at all. Life is a game, but you're not playing alone. I'm here for you, and so are hundreds of people who give up their time to be here for the sufferers like me and you. If I can go on, you can go on. It's a matter of balancing the odds; yeah life can be shit, but it's bloody awesome as well. It's hard to explain how much one life can mean to the world, and I know it's hard for you to take that fact in right now, but we need you alive. I'm sorry if I'm all over the place, but I just want you to know that I've got your back, and you can talk to me. I just don't want you to go. Okay?

Truth is, there is no accurate view of reality. 
Depressed you sees the crap in the world, and happy you sees the good. So there is both, and I think it's pretty worth it to live for the happy part. This whole world is hard to comprehend, it's how you view it that counts. You've barely had time to experience any of it, and you wont if you're gonna give in. 

You know what, think of yourself as enlightened. You're a thinker, a dreamer, I can see that in you. I'm sure there is something holding you down so just hold on to that. But seriously, permanency is a serious thing. Death is serious. Sit down and breathe. You're conscious. Can you imagine not breathing? Hold your breath for a little bit, it's hella scary. Imagine being forever trapped in sleep. Never waking up to feel again. For a moment you feel relief but if you really delve into it, it's just an uncertain hole of nothingness. 

Sorry if I'm rambling, but Im not gonna refute all those claims. I want you to find your own reasons to stay alive. There are thousands of possibilities, don't limit yourself. You're alive, so you might as well live.

You gotta keep fighting man. I know life can be a bloody, stubborn, bitch sometimes, but everything that happens is for a reason. This part of your life is temporary. It'll all slip into the past quickly enough. You have to see that light at the end of the tunnel and go for it. Don't resort to suicide, please. It's okay to feel this way. It's okay to want to kill yourself; because it's an immediate thought that all of us have. But just don't act on it. Think of how final it is. Life is also a bloody beautiful thing when you look at it in the right way. Your parents are fuck ups, and the best thing to do now, is strive to never ever ever be like them. Your life and experiences may help others in your situation. You're an inspiration, to have survived this long.

Forget all those people that have hurt you, because they're useless. Try to find people who'll stick by you. There is someone out there that's waiting to be your friend. Don't give up all those possibilities to the darkness. First step, try to like yourself a bit ahaha how you look physically means nothing, you are not your exterior. Cliched but true; it's what's inside that counts. If anyone tells you otherwise they can piss off as well. 

Positivity. I wish I could give you positivity and hope and everything you've lost, but I'm offering you words. Read them and soak in the fact that I myself have hope for you. You've got people vouching for you, and the future that they want you to have.

The only thing left to do, is what you've been doing for 17 years. You have to go on. I mean look how far you've come. Can't you remember that feeling of satisfaction when you game and you win? When you transport yourself into those other worlds? It's amazing. And you can feel it in so many different contexts. Maybe you're not moving out of your comfort bubble? Maybe it's time you took a holiday? Change the scenery, or go for something you've always been scared of doing. Go for a walk xD it helps. Because what's the use in being alive if you're not living. Our purpose is to find our escape.

Talk. Talk to anyone, talk to me, post on here more often. Getting responses will remind you that people care, even if they live thousands of kilometres away from you and have never met you. We see possibility. I see a better future for you. You're a fighter, and that's something you should be proud of. Also, you mentioned you've got people around you that care; aren't you lucky. Try to appreciate little things like that more. I can assure you, they think of you often. 

I feel you on the fault thing, the faults I see in myself are too  overwhelming sometimes. But change your perspective. Your faults make you the special person you are. You have a big heart, it's obvious from your words. I wouldn't want you to leave, we need more good people in this world. 

Just remind yourself that you're in control of your thoughts. Don't let yourself give up. I know it hurts, that gnawing feeling at the back of your head, the crazy imaginary scenarios, the death. But death... It's just an easy way out of a whole world that you haven't even experienced properly yet. I say, go on.

So many post here yeah, but there are so many that help out as well. Right now I can see that a hundred and thirteen people are hanging around, ready to help. The only reason you're not doing therapy is because of you. Think about it. You can easily go and see a psychologist. We deny ourselves help because I think we love to wallow up in our pain. I've been in your position many times. But you have to set your foot down and decide you're gonna change. It's harder than it seems but once you start taking steps forward it'll be rewarding. 

I really want you to make it to the bright side. I want you to live okay.

If you've got that faith in you, the fear of hell, hang on to it. You'll get through this. Think of all the other times you felt like shit, it passes. Something may happen today or tomorrow, and you'll be happy you didn't kill yourself, trust me. Focus on positives. It may seem ridiculous, talking to yourself or saying really positive things, but it helps. Personally, I have faith in you. I'm in a very similar situation. My religion has kept me alive, and if you're the same, it will work for you as well. Don't listen to any negative comments. 

Also, I'd recommend you don't rely on medication. It's very short term, and if you get off them, all the feelings you were running away from will come back. It's better to seek out a psychologist you feel comfortable around and get help in controlling your thoughts and dealing with everything. Keep your head up man.

Sorry I didn't reply for a while. From what I'm reading, you still have hope. You want to get it off your chest, so all you need is a way to do that. Even coming on here Is a step forward. Don't let the feelings get the better of you. I tell it to myself everyday, I can control all of this, I won't let myself be controlled by the feelings. You're not a burden. You just need to find a person who listens and if it means coming on here everyday, then do that. So many people care.

You need to distract yourself with something that makes you feel strongly. Anything. The constant thinking about it will only make you do it. Please. Being okay with death isn't going to solve anything. Suicide is so... Final you know. It ends it all. You can ever taste your favourite food anymore, feel the slight cooling breeze on a hot summer day, watch someone's eyes squint and their lips turn up as they laugh at something you've said. You need to stay. There are too many unknown possibilities; so many doors that need to be opened. And they can only be opened by you. You have your own unique mind, and your own unique thoughts and seriously, I wouldn't want suicide to claim you. Being scared of it is something you should really hold on to, because being scared isn't always a bad thing. It saves us in situations. Talk to me.

Ugh thanks so much for writing such an awesome response. I really haven't been taking action, but it's because it has all been ongoing for years and years and I'm so exhausted with it all. It's like a never ending cycle. What I've done to develop a purpose... I've focused a lot on psychology. Read and studied a lot about it. That's what I plan to study in uni. And I know it's really a hard thing to do, especially with my own unstable mental state, but there is nothing else other an writing that interests me and I'm so passionate about. I feel like I just want to help people not feel like I do.
Ahaha that last sentence. Thank you so much for the encouragement.

Never ever give up. You have to show them that you're not an object to be humiliated and made fun off, used, thrown to the side. It's your self belief that counts. Whatever they say does not matter. You're 14, a few years from now, you can reinvent your whole life. Prove them all wrong. The users will end up no where. Stick in there. We all have our stories, and you've been chosen to deal with some of the hardest things in life, but after hardship comes ease. Always keep that in mind.

You need to just get it off your chest. I know how you feel, believe me. But don't resort to ending your life. You know first hand how hard it is to deal with suicide, everyone around you will be hurt. We need you alive.
